# `assets/vehicle/VehiclePublicRuntime.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/vehicle/VehiclePublicRuntime.js`

This is intentionally the public compatibility facade. Production asset code must not import protected vehicle implementation modules.

## Functions

### `inspectPublicVehicleDrivetrain(world, driveMode)`

Fail-closed inspection of the WebIDL ratio surface used by Vehicle2.

### `configurePublicVehicleDrivetrain(controller, driveMode)`

Configure the live four-wheel differential as an exact open FWD, RWD, or AWD differential. Zero-ratio wheels receive no drive torque and do not contribute to clutch speed, as defined by the public Vehicle2 contract.

### `inspectPublicVehicleRuntime(world, profile)`

### `createPublicVehicleRuntime(world, profile, options = {})`

Create an exact runtime or return an honest unavailable receipt.

## Constants

- `VEHICLE_PUBLIC_RUNTIME_CAPABILITY`
- `VEHICLE_PUBLIC_DRIVETRAIN_CAPABILITY`
